items.text: Its members vote to keep in place the existing system, in which public health coverage is guaranteed to older, disabled, and low-income residents, most others rely on employer or subsidized private insurance, and about 8 percent of residents have no coverage.

Its members vote to keep in place the existing income support, in which mandatory pension schemes replace about 51 percent of an average worker's net earnings and a single adult with no other income is guaranteed about 6 percent of the median income.
